🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is ABOVE TREND on sector averages, with +2.36% for 1W and +5.02% for 1M. LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +8.08%) and UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.06%) are firm, while JNJ RECOVERY (1W: +4.93% | 1M: -1.81%) shows a short-term rebound.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Positioning?

Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major divergence argues for measured positioning pending confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels are not included in the data. Monitor whether LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%) and PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.54% | 1M: +4.19%) sustain momentum, and whether META BELOW TREND (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -16.11%) and AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -20.08%) stabilize.

META (+55): Nvidia partnership investment headline, but price diverges from the positive news, with META BELOW TREND (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -16.11%); monitor for follow-through.

UNH (-45): Price-target reduction is also divergent from performance, with UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.06%); GE (-40) and LRCX (-40) show weaker price confirmation, both BELOW TREND: GE (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -11.69%) and LRCX (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -24.65%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%) and PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.54% | 1M: +4.19%) show relative strength. Major divergence, including correction patterns in MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +3.18%) and MA CORRECTION (1W: -0.47% | 1M: +8.24%), plus META’s positive news/weak-price mismatch, warrants monitoring.
